text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Do you have any plans for Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There's somewhere I'd like to go
together with you, though...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Umm—
Here it is, this shop♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm looking forward to it.
I thought I'd try challenging myself
to make a silver ring today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can pull it off well...♪

The place she wanted to visit... was a hands-on
workshop where she could try making her own
accessories.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A friend of my mother's opened a shop,
and she asked me to write an experiential review for it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Pisa-chan!
Thanks for coming!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you as well.
I've been looking forward to this so much.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. There are a few more customers than usual today,
so it might get a bit hectic,
but please, make yourself at home and enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The width of the ring... yes, this should do.
What are you going to make, Trainer?

It was a special occasion.
I wanted to make something for her to express my gratitude for everything so far.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I'll go with a pinky ring.

text_block_list.text:
In that case, even if worn while running,
it shouldn't get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my♪
Shall we make it together then?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
First we'll pick the ring to work on
and heat it with the burner,
so let's head over there.

Thanks to her being experienced with making accessories from the start,
the work progressed smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...♪ Looks like it'll make a lovely hammered pattern.
How about yours, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My, what a simple design.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I really want to polish it properly.
Yeah, I want to make sure it's thoroughly polished.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I see. It's quite narrow, so it's going to turn out to be a delicate, beautiful ring.

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'd like to ask
about the parts over here.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Um, is it okay if I use
this coin ring machine~?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay!
Just a moment, please—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...You seem quite busy.
Right at that moment—
(Craaash...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right...!?
Um, let's start by picking up the shelf—

The shopkeeper, rushing around busily, accidentally
bumped into the tool rack and knocked it over.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...! It's alright, Pisa-chan, I'll clean it up right away.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
More importantly,
come on, let's get back to making the rings—
(Clang-clang)

text_block_list.name: Customer C
text_block_list.text:
Hello~♪ I'm Yamada, reservation for four.
—Wait, a-are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Ah... um—!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
Um, I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hold it firmly with your thumb, and wrap it around with the pliers—yes, just like that, well done♪

text_block_list.name: Customer C
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Even I could do it!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! Next, let's connect it to the jump ring—that small loop.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, miss! I feel like the part I picked earlier doesn't really match the rest. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we take a look at color swatches?
Do you have an overall concept in mind?

Between her naturally attentive personality and
her existing love for making accessories,
the shop was running quite smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I helped you after you finish tidying up?
It looked quite demanding.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Still... if I did that, I'd end up keeping
Trainer waiting for a really long time..."
choice_data_list: It's fine, I can wait as long as it takes.
It's okay, I can wait as long as it takes.

text_block_list.text: She can't help but take action for someone else's sake—that's just who Victoire Pisa is.

Afterward, I stepped in to help the owner,
and ended up assisting at the shop until closing time.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Thank you sooooo much for today!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm really sorry. You two were in the middle of making something, right? If you'd like, please finish making it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My—
...Are you truly certain about this?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take you up on that offer.
Um... I really wanted to finish it today no matter what.
(Clang, clang, clang...)
In the now-quiet workshop, I stood side by side with her once more, crafting rings together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Having you stay by my side
really made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...May I have your hand?

Holding out my hand as instructed,
—the freshly finished ring is placed in my palm.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas.
I made this just for you today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Having you by my side to support me all the time...
I'm so, so very grateful for that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Just a little longer until the 'Arima Kinen'.
Let's do our best together."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...The path I walk
offers very little in the way of profit.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To walk beside them means that you, too, will end up the same way.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you still treat me with such warmth.
You have no idea how much... support that gives me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Getting to know you was enough
to give birth to a certain fear within me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Please stay with me from now on, too.
I beg of you――"

The ring resting on my palm had
a soothing, hammered finish.

—I hand her
the pinky ring that was just completed.
choice_data_list: Let me give you something too
Allow me to present you with a gift as well.

text_block_list.text:
For roughly the same reason as her—
carrying years of accumulated
gratitude toward her into its creation.
choice_data_list: Your integrity is my guiding principle
Your integrity is my guiding light

text_block_list.text:
Even if I could never be like her,
I wanted to be like her.
Before I knew it, that thought had naturally taken root.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My, to think that...—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll cherish it.
Forever, and ever, and always.
